recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, minimalist studio portrait featuring a family unit dressed in matching black base layers and floor-length, grey-and-white striped chinchilla fur coats. The subjects are posed against a seamless white backdrop, creating a stark, clean aesthetic that emphasizes texture and silhouette.
coreVisualRelationships: Repetition of striped fur texture across all subjects
High-contrast relationship between black clothing and white background
Symmetrical balance between the adult figures framing the children
Uniformity of accessories including dark sunglasses and silver jewelry
coreInvariants: Floor-length fur outerwear with horizontal banding
Wide-tracked sans-serif typography at the top margin

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects are centered vertically and horizontally, occupying the middle 70% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The tallest central figure in the hooded fur coat acts as the vertical anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye moves from the top-left text to the top-right text, then drops to the faces of the adults, following the long lines of the coats down to the children.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space at the top and bottom of the frame to isolate the subjects and provide room for text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pure white background providing high-key illumination.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for base clothing and sunglasses.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Varied grays and silvers within the fur texture and jewelry.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between the black silhouettes and white environment.

composition.position: Top margin, left and right corners

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used with consistent weight and tracking for balance.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary geometric clarity and modern feel.
Open-source alternative with similar geometric proportions.
Classic geometric choice that handles wide tracking well.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a family against a seamless white background. All members wear black turtlenecks and matching floor-length chinchilla fur coats with distinct horizontal grey and white stripes. They wear black sunglasses. High-key lighting, sharp focus on fur texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two strings of uppercase geometric sans-serif text at the very top of the image. Place one string in the top-left corner and the other in the top-right corner. Use extreme letter spacing (tracking) so the text spans a significant width while remaining small in scale.

verificationChecks: Is the background pure white without shadows?
Is the fur texture highly detailed and striped?
Is the text tracking wide enough to feel airy?
Are all subjects in black base layers?

mustRedesign: Specific brand logos on jewelry or shoes
Identifiable facial features of specific celebrities
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no color bleeding into the white background
Check that the fur stripes are horizontal and consistent
Verify the text is perfectly level and aligned to top margins
Confirm all subjects are wearing dark sunglasses
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio family portrait + [Monochrome Palette] + [Striped Fur Outerwear] + [High-Key White Background] + [Wide-Tracked Geometric Sans Typography]
